description:
`changes/change/v1`: one change to a repository, at `/changes/<name>.json`.

Its other records sit in `/changes/<name>/`, each written once, and its
state is derived from which of them exist.

branch.description: The work branch in the repository.

issue.description: The URL of the issue the change answers.

repo.description: The repo record of the repository the change is to, such as /repos/board.

route.description: owner when nobody else owns a CODEOWNERS pattern, ask-first when someone does, unowned when no pattern names anyone, and unread when the board holds no checkout to read CODEOWNERS from.

suite.description: The check suite whose runs the check step reads.

title.description: What the change does, in a few words.

workflow.description: The workflow whose steps the change follows.

title: ChangeRecord
